learning_outcomes.text: Understand the basic principles of the different subjects that make up this applied and professional module.
Propose and solve problems posed in the different subjects.
Carry out market prospecting for products related to the different subjects presented, detect the strengths and weaknesses of the products, considering their economic and environmental cost.
Propose systems and carry out simulations and real projects related to the different subjects.

syllabus_topics: Formal and functional definition. CATIA 3D modeling
Reverse engineering. Data acquisition with photography and scanner
PRACTICE 1. RAPID REPRODUCTION TECHNIQUES. PART 1. SILICONE MOLD CREATION
PRACTICE 2: REPRODUCTION OF PARTS WITH RAPID POLYMERIZATION RESINS

assessment_methods.method: Experimental work tests and reports: Prototype 1
Experimental work tests and reports: Prototype 2

assessment_rules: If the minimum required for passing is not met in any section, the maximum final grade for the course will be 4.9 out of 10 (Fail). A minimum grade of 4/10 is required for the Poster. A minimum grade of 5/10 is required for Prototype 2. The Poster and Prototype 2 components are recoverable.
